Name: Name
Description: Name or identifier of the route
Possible Values: Varies. (Does not exist for all routes - can be blank).

Name: Hierarchy
Description: The function of the route within the network. For a description of the functions see: WA Cycling Network Hierarchy (transport.wa.gov.au)
Possible Values: Primary Route Secondary Route Local Route Transport Trail (formerly named Tourist Trail) Road Cycling Route Structure

Name: Class
Description: Legacy infrastructure classification (not used in all regions, is to be phased out and replaced with Infrastructure classification)
Possible Values: A Ð Existing B Ð Existing (substandard) C Ð Proposed (Does not exist for all routes - can be blank.).

Name: Strategy
Description: Name of the Regional Strategy within which the network was defined.
Possible Values: Avon-Central 2050 Bunbury-Wellington 2050 Esperance 2050 Gascoyne 2050 Geraldton 2050 Great Southern 2050 Kalgoorlie 2050 Leeuwin-Naturaliste 2050 Pilbara 2050 Warren-Blackwood 2050

Name: Infra-Class
Description: Infrastructure classification which indicates status and condition of the route

Name: Label
Possible Values: Varies. (Does not exist for all routes - can be blank).

Name: Shape_Leng
Description: Length of the route in metres
